subject: [PATCH v4 13/19] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the selftests/mm module, specifically designed to cover a shared-source collapse write race condition in the Linux kernel. The test simulates a scenario where a parent process writes to a shared range while a child process is collapsing it, and verifies that CoW (Copy-on-Write) correctly keeps the two sides apart under these conditions. The test uses a combination of fork, usleep, and pipe operations to create a realistic simulation of this race condition.
